title: Configured synthetic service fees
content: The fictional fee schedule lists INR 0 for monthly demo savings service, INR 150 for annual debit-card service, INR 100 for debit-card replacement, INR 0 for online NEFT, INR 50 for a 25-leaf cheque book, and INR 100 for the example loan late-installment charge. No other fee or tax is implied.
